feedValidator: aiofourown validateFeedV2(feed, 'cosmogenitor') ACCEPTED; a wrong project is refused (bad_project)
limits: one run, Chromium, a script drove it, the link was built by PLC's encoder from the live feed's values and not by aiofourown's page (not live yet); not Safari; no offline test; the feed is not registered with aiofourown yet.
observation: A plain Accept: application/json request to /discovery/v2.json also receives version 2 (content-type application/vnd.aiofourown.discovery.v2+json). aiofourown's rule (RULES section 2) is that a publisher must not serve version 2 to a request that did not ask for it, which matters if this URL were ever registered as a version 1 source; at a dedicated v2.json address it may be intended.
